title: Default Cover Letter Source
description: Candidate's default cover letter template strings. Used as the base layer when generating cover letters. Domain letter files (e.g. ai-letter.json) override individual fields when the file exists and the field is a non-empty string.

opening_template.description: Default opening sentence template. Supports {employer} and {job_title} placeholders. Overridden by a domain letter file when that field is a non-empty string.

closing_template.description: Default closing sentence template. Supports {employer} placeholder. Overridden by a domain letter file when that field is a non-empty string.

intro.description: Candidate's personal introduction paragraph, inserted after the opening line and before the value proposition. Leave as empty string to omit. Overridden by a domain letter file when that field is a non-empty string.
